Quote UUID (`String`). A quote is one modification to a policy (see `quote_type`: new business, endorsement, renewal, cancellation, …) and a policy accumulates many of them; each quote fans out to one row per dwelling per `quote_version`. Pair it with `quote_version` when joining or deduping (`LIMIT 1 BY quote_id` ordered by `quote_version DESC` for latest state).

When this quote (version) was issued, `Nullable(DateTime64(6))`. NULL on every non-`Issued` row, so `isNotNull(quote_issued_timestamp)` is equivalent to `quote_status = 'Issued'`. Use it to time individual endorsements/renewals; use `policy_issued_timestamp` for when the policy itself was bound.

Quote lifecycle status. Observed values (verify before use): `Draft`, `Issued`, `Quoted`, `Invalidated`. Only `Issued` quotes are bound/in effect — filter `quote_status = 'Issued'` for premium, bind, or book analyses. `Draft` rows dominate the table, which is what makes it useful for bind-rate funnels.

0-based policy-term index (`Int64`): `0` is the original new-business term and each renewal increments it (`Renewal` quotes are always `>= 1`). Idiom — policies bound (new business) in month X: `quote_status = 'Issued' AND quote_term_number = 0 AND policy_issued_timestamp` in X, counting `DISTINCT policy_id`.

What the quote does to the policy. Observed values (verify before use): `NewBusiness`, `Endorsement`, `Renewal`, `Cancellation`, `Reinstatement`, `Legacy`. `NewBusiness` quotes always have `quote_term_number = 0` and `Renewal` always `>= 1`, so term number is the cleaner new-vs-renewal filter.

`Int64` revision counter within a `quote_id`, starting at `1` (heavily edited quotes run to hundreds). A `quote_id` can appear with more than one version, so current quote state = highest version: `ORDER BY quote_version DESC LIMIT 1 BY quote_id` — the latest-version state the `dbt_mga` marts reflect.

Derived new-business sequence metric joined on (`dwelling_id`, `quote_id`); NULL when the pair has no sequence row (sequences are built only from `quote_type = 'NewBusiness'` / `modification_category = 'newbusiness'` quotes). A dwelling's new-business quotes are grouped into sequences (a >120-day gap between quote creations starts a new sequence, counting one row per sequence and one per issued date within it); `quoted_count` is the total row count of that expansion.
